upstream_position: After actual syntax/typed candidateGraph; before closeEdges/Eligibility/Boundary IR/Canonical

origin.migration: Operations, modalities, entity meta-types and role model reused; parser regex and Lark excluded.
Reuse all existing entry IDs; add explicit software/AI frames; Unicode code points; portable schema identities.

candidate_domain: Existing EVENT and ENTITY/REFERENCE/UNKNOWN_REFERENT endpoints in the same clause, explicit dependency or existing typed edge; no arbitrary proximity product.
grounding_catalog: Frozen action/ontology operation components from L1/L2, independently retrieved by BGE and E5
NLI: Typed predicate, endpoint-role, modality and source-condition hypotheses. Retain every prediction and token-limit result; NLI never licenses admission.
limitations: Only relation proposals on existing endpoints; no new semantic node or owner/frame invention. Missing endpoints remain outside the proposer domain.
Pack action candidates and NLI are retained signals; this bounded lane does not install a new action sense based on retrieval.
Typed NLI hypothesis construction is diagnostic and not an independent universal semantic-role validator.
Cases with zero eligible pairs make no per-case model calls; do not count resource availability as a semantic gain.
